text:
lina: hey team — quick one. I'm trying to open the model-status panel for ap-southeast-1 to triage a p95 spike but Grafana returns a 403. Anyone have the canonical shortlink or the correct permission group to request?

tony: which dashboard exactly? the regional service-overview or the per-model latency one?

lina: the per-model latency (it shows p50/p95/rps per model). In Grafana nav it's Observability > Regions > APAC > Model status. Error says "You need permissions to view this dashboard".

ash: try this link (should go straight to the panel): https://grafana.redwood.net/d/3f1b7c2/model-status?orgId=1&var-region=ap-southeast-1 — if you get 403 it's a perms thing.

lina: still 403 with that exact link.

sam: @lina file a perm request at infra service: https://infra.redwood.net/perm-requests — include grafana id `3f1b7c2` and request group `eng-oncall-read` or `observability-read`. Use reason: "urgent triage: p95 spike for embed models in ap-southeast". I can approve faster if you tag me.

lina: created ticket 6789, tagged @sam.

infra-bot: perm-request created: PR-6789 — awaiting approvals (approver: sam).

ash: if you need numbers now, I can export the last 15m from the panel. Also logs live in Loki: https://logs.redwood.net/explore?orgId=1&left=%7B%22datasource%22:%22loki%22%7D and traces in Tempo: https://tempo.redwood.net/search?service=embed-service&env=ap-southeast-1

lina: would appreciate the export — seeing p95 for embed-model-x spike to ~1.2s starting 08:40 UTC. rps steady.

ash: pasted CSV (trimmed):
```
model, p50(ms), p95(ms), rps
embed-model-x, 230, 1204, 12.4
embed-model-y, 190, 310, 8.1
```

tony: looks like a tail latency issue for embed-model-x. Could be cold cache or slow kernels. ops/infra will add you to eng-oncall-read once PR-6789 approved.

sam: small note on ticket: set urgency=high and attach your SSO email; infra team auto-mints the role after approval. If you want immediate ad-hoc access I can generate a signed Grafana temp link (1hr) — say if you need to run queries now.

lina: temp link would be great if you can.

sam: generating... https://grafana.redwood.net/d-solo/3f1b7c2/model-status?orgId=1&panelId=4&temp=1h — paste that in browser incognito.

lina: that worked, can see graphs now. thank you! will keep ticket updated with findings.

ash: follow-up: if this repeats, let's open an eval for model-level kernel perf and also add a quick alert tuning: raise p95 threshold for embed-model-x by 50% while we investigate to reduce pager noise.

tony: ++ on alert tuning proposal. lina, file a short PR in observability-config with the alert change and tag me for review.

lina: will do, thanks all :)
